collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After overhearing a lively exchange of village news, a scholar wonders whether people everywhere share stories about each other.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After overhearing a lively exchange of village news, (name1), a scholar, wonders whether people everywhere share stories about each other.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder says gossip can be harmless or hurtful anywhere, depending on the teller.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child imagines a very quiet place where nobody knows anything about anyone.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A teenager decides that sounds very boring indeed.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees that good news should travel faster than bad.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager admits they have spread a story they should not have, and decides to be more careful.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The villagers imagine distant neighbors whispering about who burned the stew, and laugh.
